summary: A humorous profile series on local inventors, treated as modern-day Mad Scientists, each with a quirky, usually failing invention launched between September 2023 and March 2024. The inventions include a perpetual motion machine, a seed grenade, an amphibious jetpack-sneaker, a syrup-spraying drone, a flavor cooker, a wearable helicopter hat, and a messy painting robot. The note celebrates their determination, optimism and duct tape in the face of the laws of physics.
one_line: Tongue-in-cheek profiles of seven local inventors and their quirky, mostly failed gadgets, from the Eterni-Spinner to the AutoArtist.
key_facts: Dr. Harold "Spinner" Jenkins unveiled the "Eterni-Spinner", a claimed perpetual motion machine, on September 3, 2023; it uses magnets, hamster wheels and an old record of "The Twist".
The Eterni-Spinner can reportedly power an LED for five minutes before sputtering and shutting down; energy experts remain skeptical.
Cynthia "Seed Bomb" McDougal launched the G.T. Bomb (short for "Growthtastic"), a grenade-shaped vessel meant to turn wastelands into lush paradises, on October 14, 2023 from her backyard garden.
McDougal was trained as a surrealist and described the G.T. Bomb as "just another blast of greenery...literally!"

Phillip "Aqua" Finley promoted the HydroHopper, an amphibious device made of flipper-equipped sneaker soles and a water jetpack, with a public unveiling dated November 21, 2023 (the text also gives November 28, 2023).

The HydroHopper's jetpack was filled with water siphoned from public pools, and the Coast Guard disapproved of Finley bobbing along shorelines; the description in the note degenerates into repetitive text.

Betty "Buzzer" Langley's SkySweep window-cleaning drone sprayed maple syrup instead of glass cleaner on its December 5, 2023 maiden voyage, causing sticky downtown high rises and a brief surge in urban bees.
Langley said "cleanliness may be next but stickiness is just around the corner."
Gus "Gourmet" Trevino unveiled the "Flavo-Flux Induction Cooker" on January 15, 2024, which claims to impart any flavor using magnetic fields; he turned tofu into something tasting like wagyu beef.
Trevino responded to criticism with "It's best served confused!"
Nancy "Nimbus" Nguyen tried the "CopterCap", a hard hat with collapsible rotors, on February 10, 2024, hovered inches off the ground for several seconds, then crash-landed in a hedge.
Eugene "Eureka" Evers unveiled the "AutoArtist", an autonomous painter robot, on March 12, 2024; its output resembled Pollock more than Picasso and he called it "abstract expressionism incarnate".
